quests.name: Maple Island quests (all 10)
quests.inGame: In game: 20 quests from 10 NPCs, from Borrowing Sera's Mirror to Rain's Maple Quiz 7
quests.summary: Do all 20 short quests from 10 Maple Island NPCs before you take the one-way boat. You get 1,075 EXP, exactly the 300 mesos the boat costs, The Green Relaxer chair, a random dagger and a random skullcap or headband.
quests.card: Do every Maple Island quest before the one-way boat: Pio's boxes, Rain's 7-part quiz, Mai's training and more.
cardRewards: Fruit Knife|Fruit Knife or Razor (random dagger)

start.directions: Heena is in the first area of Maple Island. She explains the basic controls and gives the first quest.

collect.name: Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece
collect.note: For Todd's How-to-Hunt.

collect.name: Blue Snail Shell
collect.note: For Biggs.

collect.name: Orange Mushroom Cap
collect.note: For Biggs.

collect.name: Old Wooden Board
collect.note: For Pio. Same Wooden Boxes as the Rusty Screws.

collect.name: Sera's Mirror
collect.note: Given by Sera. Bring it to Heena.

collect.name: Maria's Letter
collect.note: Given by Maria. Deliver it to Lucas.

collect.name: Lucas's Letter
collect.note: Given by Lucas. Deliver it to Maria.

steps.text: Talk to Heena and accept Borrowing Sera's Mirror. Walk up the hill to the east and talk to Sera, who is hanging laundry. She gives you Sera's Mirror.
Bring the mirror back to Heena (2 EXP). Then take the shiny portal on the right (press Up) to the next area.
Talk to Roger and take Roger's Apple. Open your inventory (I), go to the Use tab and double-click the apple to eat it. Talk to Roger again to finish (no reward).
Talk to Nina, then walk right to her brother Sen and ask what he wants for dinner (Mushroom Soup). Go back and tell Nina (3 EXP).
Accept Todd's How-to-Hunt. Defeat 3 Tutorial Jr. Sentinels, pick up 3 Jr. Sentinel Shellpieces and give them to Peter on the same map (10 EXP, 3 Eggs). If Peter won't take them, try Todd.
Accept Sam's Suggestion from Sam and defeat 10 Snails. Keep walking east to A Split Road and talk to Mai to finish it (30 EXP, 5 Eggs). If Mai won't take it, go back to Sam.
At Lv2+, talk to Maria on A Split Road and accept Letter for Lucas. She gives you Maria's Letter to take to Lucas in Amherst.
At Lv3+, accept Mai's Training: 10 Blue Snails, 10 Shrooms and 5 Red Snails. Not Lv3 yet? Hunt a few monsters here first.
Before you hunt, step over to Southperry (it connects to A Split Road) and accept Biggs's Collection of Items: 10 Blue Snail Shells and 1 Orange Mushroom Cap. Don't take the boat yet.
Back on A Split Road, defeat 10 Blue Snails, 10 Shrooms and 5 Red Snails. Pick up every Blue Snail Shell; Biggs needs 10.
Hand in Mai's Training (80 EXP, 10 Eggs). Accept Mai's Final Training: defeat 1 Orange Mushroom. Leave it open; you'll hand it in on the way back.
Go on to The Field West of Amherst. Defeat Orange Mushrooms until you have 1 Orange Mushroom Cap; the first kill also counts for Mai. Finish your 10 Blue Snail Shells here if needed.
Continue to Amherst and give Maria's Letter to Lucas, near the store. Accept Lucas's Reply; he gives you Lucas's Letter for Maria.
At Lv5+, talk to Pio and accept Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods. Break Wooden Boxes in Amherst or The Field West of Amherst until you have 2 Rusty Screws and 2 Old Wooden Boards.
Hand the screws and boards to Pio: 100 EXP, 150 mesos and The Green Relaxer chair.
At Lv5+, talk to Rain in Amherst and answer all 7 Maple Quiz questions (answers in Tips). They give 490 EXP in total, plus 10 Oranges from the last one.
Walk back to A Split Road. Hand Mai's Final Training to Mai (120 EXP, 150 mesos, 10 Eggs) and give Lucas's Letter to Maria (120 EXP plus a random skullcap or headband).
Go to Southperry and give Biggs the 10 Blue Snail Shells and the Orange Mushroom Cap (120 EXP plus a Fruit Knife or a Razor, 50/50).
Check your quest log: every Maple Island quest should be done and The Green Relaxer in your inventory. Then, at Lv7+ with 300 mesos, talk to Shanks to sail to Lith Harbor. There's no way back.

items.name: The Green Relaxer
items.note: Chair from Pio. Untradeable; restores 30 HP every 10 s while you sit

items.name: Fruit Knife
items.note: From Biggs: you get this or a Razor, 50/50

items.name: Razor
items.note: From Biggs: you get this or a Fruit Knife, 50/50

items.name: Random skullcap or headband
items.note: From Lucas's Reply: Brown or Green Skullcap, or a Red, Black, Green, Yellow or Blue Headband

rewards.other: Rain's 7 quizzes pay 40 to 100 EXP each, 490 in all.

quests.missable: The Green Relaxer chair only comes from Pio, can't be traded or bought, and the boat from Southperry is one-way. Finish Pio's quest (and every other island quest) before you sail, or the chair is gone for good. Already left? Mina in Lith Harbor sells the Sky-blue Wooden Chair for 1,000 mesos as a backup.
tips: Rain's quiz answers, by meaning (pick the option that says this, wherever it sits): 1) Up arrow key, 2) Yes, double-click to wear it, 3) Equipment Inventory, 4) Sleep, the one that does NOT restore HP, 5) Level 10, 6) 5 points, 7) Southperry.
If Quiz 4 asks how you DO recover HP instead, pick the potion or chair answer.
Take Biggs's quest before you hunt for Mai. Mai's Blue Snails drop the shells Biggs wants, and one Orange Mushroom hunt covers Mai's Final Training and Biggs's cap.
Pio's Wooden Boxes take 4 hits each. Amherst has 7 (100 s respawn); The Field West of Amherst has 5 (60 s respawn). Walking the Amherst street twice is usually enough.
Mai's Final Training and Pio each pay 150 mesos: exactly the 300-meso boat fare. Keep it for the boat.
Finishing every island quest puts you at about Lv8. In Lith Harbor, Olaf has your next quest (Olaf's First Training, Lv8). Founder's Package mail only works once you're off the island.
unknowns: Nobody has confirmed whether Rusty Screws and Old Wooden Boards drop when Pio's quest isn't active, so accept it before you break boxes.
If Equipment Inventory (Quiz 3) or Southperry (Quiz 7) is marked wrong, try Item Inventory or "No way I can get there!" instead.

quests.name: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Request
quests.inGame: In game: Don Hwang's Request, Shumi's Request and Andre's Request
quests.summary: Pay Nella in Kerning City a 1,000-meso fee, then do three hunting errands for Don Hwang, Shumi and Andre. You get 564 EXP, 1,053 mesos, Work Gloves, 15 Lemons, 20 Cakes and 2 Return Scrolls to Kerning City.
quests.card: Pay Nella 1,000 mesos, then do three errands: Orange Mushrooms and Ribbon Pigs, Dark Stumps, then Octopus plus a Pure Water.

start.directions: Nella stands in Kerning City itself. The maps for her first errand, Kerning City Middle Forest and L Forest, are in the Kerning area.

steps.text: At Lv10+, talk to Nella in Kerning City and pay her 1,000-meso fee to accept Don Hwang's Request.
Defeat 20 Orange Mushrooms and 20 Ribbon Pigs, and collect 10 Orange Mushroom Caps and 10 Pig's Ribbons. Kerning City Middle Forest I-III have both monsters.
Return to Nella: 188 EXP, 351 mesos, 15 Lemons and 2 Return Scrolls to Kerning City. Then accept Shumi's Request.
Defeat 25 Dark Stumps and collect 15 Leaves. Construction Site North of Kerning City has some; the Perion fields (West Domain of Perion, East Rocky Mountain III-V) have the most.

steps.text: Return to Nella: 188 EXP, 351 mesos and 20 Cakes. Then accept Andre's Request.
Defeat 30 Octopus and collect 20 Octopus Legs at Kerning City Construction Site, Caution Falling Down or Northern Top of Construction Site.
Buy 1 Pure Water (1,120 mesos) from the 24 Hr Mobile Store or Mr. Sweatbottom in Sleepywood, or from Valen at Florina Beach.
Bring the Octopus Legs and Pure Water to Nella: 188 EXP, 351 mesos and Work Gloves. Her next three requests open at Lv22.

items.name: Work Gloves
items.note: From Andre's Request. Lv10, W.DEF +6, CRIT +1%, 5 slots, tradeable

rewards.other: After the 1,000-meso fee and the 1,120-meso Pure Water, you end about 1,067 mesos down.

tips: Only the first errand (Don Hwang's Request) charges the 1,000-meso fee. Shumi's and Andre's Requests list no fee.
Kerning City Middle Forest I-III have both Orange Mushrooms and Ribbon Pigs, so you can do Don Hwang's whole hunt on one map.
Pure Water isn't sold in Kerning. Buy one whenever you pass through Sleepywood or Florina Beach so you don't need a special trip.
Use your 2 Return Scrolls to Kerning City to get back to Nella from the Perion fields or Sleepywood.
Keep extra Octopus Legs. Mrs. Ming Ming's chain needs 30 more, so farm 50 in one trip if you're doing both.
unknowns: Nella's exact spot in Kerning City since the Oct 15 Kerning rework isn't confirmed.
Jane in Lith Harbor may also sell Pure Water, but nobody has confirmed it.

quests.name: Maple World's Unique Fun: Omok
quests.inGame: In game: six quests, from Make a Slime & Mushroom Omok Set to Make a Pig & Octopus Omok Set
quests.summary: Bring Casey in Henesys Park an Omok Table and two Omok Pieces from monster drops, six times over, and he makes you six Omok sets. Each set pays 334 EXP and 409 mesos (2,004 EXP and 2,454 mesos for all six).
quests.card: Bring Casey six Omok Tables from Stumps, plus matching pieces from Slimes, Pigs, Orange Mushrooms and Octopus.
cardRewards: Slime & Mushroom Omok Set|6 Omok sets

start.directions: Henesys Park is a town map next to Henesys. It connects to Henesys and Henesys Market.

steps.text: At Lv12+, go to Henesys Park and talk to Casey. Accept Make a Slime & Mushroom Omok Set.

Get 1 Omok Table from Stumps, 1 Omok Piece: Slime from Slimes and 1 Omok Piece: Mushroom from Orange Mushrooms. The Field South of Ellinia has Stumps and Slimes; Henesys Hunting Ground II-III have Orange Mushrooms.
Bring them to Casey: 334 EXP, 409 mesos and a Slime & Mushroom Omok Set. Accept Make a Slime & Pig Omok Set.
Get a new table (Stump), a Slime piece (Slime) and a Pig piece (Pig). A Hill West of Henesys has Stumps and Pigs; Henesys Hunting Ground III has Slimes.
Hand them to Casey for the Slime & Pig Omok Set (334 EXP, 409 mesos). Accept Make a Slime & Octopus Omok Set.
Get a table (Stump), a Slime piece (Slime) and an Octopus piece (Octopus). Kerning City Construction Site has Stumps and Octopus.
Hand them to Casey for the Slime & Octopus Omok Set (334 EXP, 409 mesos). Accept Make a Pig & Mushroom Omok Set.
Get a table (Stump), a Pig piece (Pig) and a Mushroom piece (Orange Mushroom). A Hill West of Henesys has Stumps and Pigs; Henesys Hunting Ground II-III have Orange Mushrooms.
Hand them to Casey for the Pig & Mushroom Omok Set (334 EXP, 409 mesos). Accept Make a Octopus & Mushroom Omok Set.
Get a table (Stump), an Octopus piece (Octopus) and a Mushroom piece (Orange Mushroom). Kerning City Construction Site has all three monsters.
Hand them to Casey for the Octopus & Mushroom Omok Set (334 EXP, 409 mesos). Accept Make a Pig & Octopus Omok Set.
Get a table (Stump), a Pig piece (Pig) and an Octopus piece (Octopus). Kerning City Construction Site has Stumps and Octopus; L Forest I-II have Pigs.
Hand them to Casey for the last set, the Pig & Octopus Omok Set (334 EXP, 409 mesos).

rewards.other: Each of the 6 quests pays 334 EXP and 409 mesos. An Omok set opens an Omok game room wherever you're allowed to play.

tips: The six quests unlock one at a time, and each set has its own table and pieces, so collect for the set you're on.

Every set needs a table from Stumps, so hunt where Stumps share a map: The Field South of Ellinia and The Tree That Grew II (Slimes), A Hill West of Henesys (Pigs), Kerning City Construction Site (Octopus and Orange Mushrooms).
Octopus pieces come from Kerning-area maps, not Henesys. For the last three sets, Kerning City Construction Site and L Forest I-II cover every monster you need.
You can't start an Omok game in the Free Market Entrance.
Casey also has a separate Lv12 quest, Make a Match Cards Set (334 EXP, 409 mesos, Set of Match Cards).
unknowns: Only the Stump table drop is confirmed. Each piece is expected from the monster it's named after, as the quest text says.
Nobody has confirmed whether tables and pieces drop when their quest isn't active.
What Casey gives for an Omok high score isn't known yet.

quests.inGame: In game: Welcome to the Free Market!, Chief Stan's Reply, Asking Perion for Help and Dances with Balrog's Reply
quests.summary: Carry letters for Lewis at the Free Market Entrance to Chief Stan in Henesys and Dances with Balrog in Perion, and bring their replies back. No hunting: four short quests for 1,696 EXP, 1,224 mesos and 20 Blue Potions.
quests.card: Carry Lewis's letters to Chief Stan in Henesys and Dances with Balrog in Perion, and bring their replies back.

start.directions: Take the magic-stone portal in Henesys or Perion to the Free Market Entrance. Lewis is there.

collect.name: Lewis's Letter (to Chief Stan)

collect.note: Given by Lewis.

steps.text: At Lv13+, take the magic-stone portal in Henesys or Perion to the Free Market Entrance. Talk to Lewis and accept Welcome to the Free Market! He gives you a letter for Chief Stan.
Go to Henesys and give the letter to Chief Stan (424 EXP, 306 mesos). Accept Chief Stan's Reply; he gives you his letter for Lewis.
Go back to Lewis in the Free Market Entrance and hand over the reply (424 EXP, 306 mesos, 10 Blue Potions). Accept Asking Perion for Help; he gives you a letter for Dances with Balrog.
Go to Perion and give the letter to Dances with Balrog in the Warriors' Sanctuary (424 EXP, 306 mesos). Accept Dances with Balrog's Reply.
Take Perion's Free Market portal back and give the reply to Lewis (424 EXP, 306 mesos, 10 Blue Potions).

rewards.other: Each of the 4 parts pays 424 EXP and 306 mesos.

tips: It's all delivery, no hunting, but it takes two round trips. Do it when you're passing between Henesys and Perion anyway.
Return Scrolls and Teleport Rocks don't work inside the Free Market Entrance, so walk out through the portal.
The 20 Blue Potions would cost 4,400 mesos in NPC shops (220 each).
unknowns: The exact spots of the Free Market portals in Henesys and Perion aren't confirmed yet.
Nobody has confirmed whether leaving the Free Market always takes you back to the town you came in from.

quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Second Worry
quests.inGame: In game: Mrs. Ming Ming's Second Worry, Estelle's Request and Estelle's Special Sauce
quests.summary: Help Mrs. Ming Ming with carnival food: visit Estelle in The Field South of Ellinia, trade her a Garnet for her special sauce, then bring it back with 10 Pig's Heads and 30 Octopus Legs. Three quests: 2,007 EXP, 1,491 mesos, 10 Red Potions, 20 Lemons and a Ribboned Pig Headband.
quests.card: Visit Estelle south of Ellinia, trade her a Garnet for sauce, then bring 10 Pig's Heads and 30 Octopus Legs to Mrs. Ming Ming.

start.directions: Mrs. Ming Ming is in Henesys town. She offers this after you finish her First Worry.

prereqs: Finish Mrs. Ming Ming's First Worry first (10 Slime Bubbles and 20 Pig's Ribbons; it pays 669 EXP, 497 mesos and 20 Lemons).

collect.name: Garnet
collect.note: Refine 1 Garnet Ore at Arcforge (Lv1 recipe, 200-meso fee), or trade for one.

collect.name: Pig's Head
collect.note: Rare, so this can take a while.

collect.name: Octopus Leg

steps.text: Finish Mrs. Ming Ming's First Worry if you haven't (10 Slime Bubbles, 20 Pig's Ribbons). Then talk to her again in Henesys and accept Mrs. Ming Ming's Second Worry.
Walk to The Field South of Ellinia via The Hill East of Henesys, The Rain-Forest East of Henesys, The Forest East of Henesys, The Forest South of Ellinia and The Forest of Wisdom.
Talk to Estelle to finish Second Worry (669 EXP, 497 mesos). Accept Estelle's Request: she wants 1 Garnet.
Get 1 Garnet: refine a Garnet Ore at Arcforge (Lv1 recipe, 200-meso fee) or get one from another player.
Give Estelle the Garnet (669 EXP, 497 mesos, 10 Red Potions). Accept Estelle's Special Sauce; she gives you the sauce.
Collect 10 Pig's Heads from Pigs and Ribbon Pigs on A Hill West of Henesys, The Forest East of Henesys or L Forest I. They're rare, so this can take a while.
Collect 30 Octopus Legs from Octopus at Kerning City Construction Site, Caution Falling Down or Northern Top of Construction Site.
Bring the sauce, 10 Pig's Heads and 30 Octopus Legs to Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys (669 EXP, 497 mesos, Ribboned Pig Headband, 20 Lemons). If she won't take them, try Estelle.

rewards.other: Each of the 3 quests pays 669 EXP and 497 mesos. The story continues at Lv27 with Mrs. Ming Ming's Concern.

tips: Nella's Andre's Request also needs 20 Octopus Legs, so farm 50 in one Kerning trip if you're doing both.
Pig's Heads are rare. Keep any you find while farming Pig's Ribbons for the First Worry, since Pigs and Ribbon Pigs share maps.
A Garnet can be traded, but new accounts are trade-locked until 24 h after any character on the account reaches Lv15.
Older guides put Estelle near The Hill East of Henesys. Look for her in The Field South of Ellinia instead.
unknowns: Where Arcforge is, and whether you must start Arcforge crafting before you can refine a Garnet, isn't confirmed.
Nobody has confirmed which monsters drop Garnet Ore yet.
How often Pig's Heads drop isn't confirmed.

quests.name: Dr. Betty's Research on Plants
quests.inGame: In game: Winston's Fossil Dig-up (2 quests), then Dr. Betty's Research on Plants (4 quests)
quests.summary: Dig up fossils for Winston in Perion, help Dr. Betty in Ellinia study them, then finish back at Winston for Leaf Earrings (Lv25), 15 Blue Potions, 15 Oranges and 5 Meat. The last step takes a pair of Weighted Earrings, so keep yours.
quests.card: Fossils for Winston, plant samples for Betty, a quiz from her daughter Anne, then materials and Weighted Earrings back to Winston.

start.directions: From Perion, walk to Perion Street Corner, then East Rocky Mountain I, then East Rocky Mountain II. Winston is on that map.

prereqs: Finish Winston's 2 fossil quests first (Searching for Fossils and Delivering a Box of Fossils). Betty won't give you her quests until you do.
Have 1 pair of Weighted Earrings for the last quest. They come from Alex the Runaway Kid (a 50/50 roll) or from Serabi the Fairy in the Ellinia Weapon Store for 9,000 mesos.

collect.name: Plant Fossil
collect.note: For Searching for Fossils. Quest item, can't be traded.

collect.name: Animal Fossil
collect.note: For Searching for Fossils. Quest item, can't be traded.

collect.name: Plant Sample
collect.note: Break Ellinia Flowers (4 hits each) north of Ellinia. The Forest North of Ellinia has the most (24).

collect.name: Leaf
collect.note: Tradeable.

collect.name: Firewood
collect.note: Tradeable.

collect.name: Stump's Teardrop
collect.note: Rare. Quest item, can't be traded.

collect.name: Weighted Earrings
collect.note: From Alex the Runaway Kid (50/50 roll), or bought from Serabi the Fairy in Ellinia for 9,000 mesos.

steps.text: Walk from Perion to Winston on East Rocky Mountain II and accept Searching for Fossils.
Defeat 25 Axe Stumps and collect 12 Plant Fossils. Axe Stumps live on Winston's own map and on East Rocky Mountain III.
Defeat 25 Green Mushrooms and collect 12 Animal Fossils. West Rocky Mountain III, on the west side of Perion, has the most Green Mushrooms.
Bring the fossils to Winston and accept Delivering a Box of Fossils. He gives you a Fossil Box and a letter of introduction for Betty.
Take the box and letter to Betty in Ellinia, then accept Research on Plant Fossils.
Break Ellinia Flowers for 8 Plant Samples. The Forest North of Ellinia has the most; reach it through The Field Up North of Ellinia and The Tree That Grew I.
Give Betty the 8 Plant Samples, then accept Research on Animal Fossils.
Go to Anne on The Hill East of Henesys (one map east of Henesys) and answer her 7 questions to prove Betty sent you. Answers are in the tips.
Accept Transporting Drake's Skull from Anne and carry the Stuffed Drake Skull back to Betty in Ellinia.
Accept Progress on Fossil Research. Betty gives you a Fossil Report.
Collect 20 Leaves from Dark Stumps (East Rocky Mountain I), 15 Firewood from Axe Stumps or Dark Axe Stumps, and 1 Stump's Teardrop from Dark Axe Stumps (East Rocky Mountain IV-VII).
Bring the Fossil Report, the materials and 1 pair of Weighted Earrings to Winston on East Rocky Mountain II (not Betty). He gives you the Leaf Earrings.

rewards.other: EXP and mesos are for Betty's 4 quests (982 EXP and 555 mesos each). Winston's 2 fossil quests add 1,964 EXP, 1,110 mesos, 15 Blue Potions and 15 Eggs, so all 6 pay 5,892 EXP and 3,330 mesos.

quests.missable: The last quest takes a pair of Weighted Earrings. Keep the pair from Alex the Runaway Kid. If you sold it, Serabi the Fairy in Ellinia sells one for 9,000 mesos.
tips: Anne's quiz answers: 'Your mom asked me to see you.'; 'She asked me to get a Stuffed Drake Skull from you.'; Betty; shoes: Yellow; book: Red; earrings: Yellow. For 'Where did you meet my mom?' pick Kerning City, not Ellinia (not yet confirmed by players).
You only need 8 Plant Samples. Older guides say 20.
Grab the 20 Leaves from Dark Stumps on East Rocky Mountain I on your first walk to Winston. Maya and the Weird Medicine wants 30 more, so farm 50 if you plan both.
To reach Anne, take a taxi to Henesys and walk one map east. Walking from Ellinia is 6 maps.
Stump's Teardrop is rare. Players report getting it anywhere from the first Dark Axe Stump kill to 10-20 kills.
Leaf Earrings need Lv25 and beat the Lv20 Weighted Earrings you hand in: +24 vs +22 M.DEF, +2 vs +1 avoid, plus 5 MP.
unknowns: No player has confirmed the answer to Anne's 'Where did you meet my mom?'. Kerning City is listed as correct, even though you meet Betty in Ellinia. It's also not known if a wrong answer lets you retry.
It's not confirmed whether Weighted Earrings you're wearing count for the hand-in. To be safe, take them off before you talk to Winston.
Betty's exact spot inside Ellinia isn't confirmed yet.

quests.name: Alex the Runaway Kid
quests.summary: Patch things up between runaway Alex in Kerning City and his dad, Chief Stan in Henesys. Three quick quests pay 15 Blue Potions, 5 Meat and a random earring: Weighted Earrings or Yellow Square.
quests.card: Hunt Green and Blue Mushrooms for Chief Stan, get through his talk, then bring Alex his mother's gold watch.
cardRewards: Weighted Earrings|Weighted Earrings or Yellow Square (random)

maps: Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North IV
Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North IV

Go to Chief Stan in Henesys. Talking to him finishes Alex's Request. Accept Talking to Stan.
Defeat 25 Blue Mushrooms and collect 15 Blue Mushroom Caps in The Blue Mushroom Forest, 4 maps east of Henesys.
Defeat 25 Green Mushrooms and collect 15 Green Mushroom Caps. Henesys Hunting Ground III is the closest Green Mushroom map to Henesys.
Bring the caps to Chief Stan and answer his 6 questions (answers in the tips). Then accept Mother's Gold Watch and take his late wife's Old Gold Watch.

quests.missable: The earring is a single 50/50 roll. If you get Weighted Earrings, keep them: the last quest of Dr. Betty's Research on Plants takes a pair.

Alex is sorry for running away!'; 'Why don't you ask Alex yourself?'; 'I think you hide the fact that you're actually a warm person.'; 'Alex's been unsettled since his mother passed away...'; 'If you truly believe that, you should try to reconcile with him.'
Jane and the Mushroom (Lv20) also wants 15 Blue Mushroom Caps, so collect 30 if you plan both.
Got Yellow Square instead? You still need Weighted Earrings for Dr. Betty's Research on Plants. Serabi the Fairy in Ellinia sells them for 9,000 mesos.
Alex's story continues at Lv27 in the Kerning City citizenship quests (A Lost Thank-You).
unknowns: It's not confirmed whether a wrong answer to Chief Stan lets you try again.
Alex's exact spot in Kerning City isn't confirmed yet.

quests.name: Jane and the Mushroom
quests.summary: Kill Blue and Horny Mushrooms and bring Jane in Lith Harbor 15 caps of each. You get a random 60% weapon attack scroll.
quests.card: Kill 30 Blue and 30 Horny Mushrooms and bring Jane 15 caps of each.

start.directions: Jane is in Lith Harbor. Take a taxi to Lith Harbor if you're elsewhere.

maps: Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North III
Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North III

steps.text: Talk to Jane in Lith Harbor and accept Jane and the Mushroom.
Defeat 30 Blue Mushrooms and collect 15 Blue Mushroom Caps in The Blue Mushroom Forest, 4 maps east of Henesys.
Defeat 30 Horny Mushrooms and collect 15 Horny Mushroom Caps. Try The Swamp of Despair II, two maps from Kerning City, or Ant Tunnel III/IV past Sleepywood.

Dying no longer ends the run, but it ends if the party drops to 2.
Cloto's coupon answers and stage help are on this site's KPQ guide.
unknowns: It's not confirmed whether everyone in the party gets credit for the same King Slime kill. Have all 4 accept the quest before you go in.

unknowns: The best maps for Pigs, Ribbon Pigs and Wild Boars (for Leather and Stiff Feathers) aren't confirmed yet.

quests.card: Kill Stirges for 20 Broken Mirror Glass, then Zombie Mushrooms for 25 Charms of the Undead.

Bring the glass to Jane Doe for 20 Blue Potions, then accept Stranger's Identity.
Defeat 50 Zombie Mushrooms and collect 25 Charms of the Undead in the Ant Tunnel past Sleepywood. Ant Tunnel III has the most.

Maya's Arcon's Blood? wants 75 Zombie Mushrooms and 40 Charms. Plan one Ant Tunnel trip for 65 Charms if you'll do both.
Stirges fly, so ranged attacks or magic make the glass hunt easier.
Players reported the Old Raggedy Cape selling for about 10k mesos on the Free Market in launch week.
Jane Doe's story continues in the Kerning City citizenship quests at Lv37 (Worn Bandages). Her Lv47 quest, An Old Grudge, is the Shade kill.
unknowns: No player has confirmed which monster drops Broken Mirror Glass. Stirges are the best bet, since Jane Doe names them. If they drop nothing, try Wild Boars.
It's not confirmed whether the glass only drops while Stranger's Request is active, so accept the quest before you hunt.
The hospital door's exact spot in Kerning City isn't confirmed, and the Oct 15 Kerning update may have moved things.

Pig Illustrated is a decent Lv25 weapon if you use one-handed blunt weapons. If not, sell it to an NPC for 5,500 mesos.
unknowns: Nobody has confirmed whether the Super Ribbon Pigs hurt you on touch. Keep moving and steer clear of them.
The exact spot of the farm's portal in The Forest East of Henesys isn't confirmed yet.

steps.text: Do your mentor's Lv10 starter quest if you haven't yet. You can only take a profession's In My Own Right! quest after you've learned it.
Raise that profession to Lv5. Crafting Lv5 needs character Lv25. See the Crafting page for leveling and for making Screws.
Craft the item your mentor wants (see the tips for each mentor). Leave the catalyst slot empty. Everything except The Red Relaxer is tradeable, so you can also buy it.
Talk to your mentor and accept the quest: Silas Irons or Mr. Thunder in Perion, Francois in Ellinia, Vicious in Henesys Market, JM From tha Streetz in Kerning City, Chrishrama in Sleepywood.
If two of your quests want the same monster (Silas and Vicious both want Dark Axe Stumps; Francois and JM both want Wild Boars), accept both before you hunt.
Kill the 30 monsters your mentor asks for. Silas wants two kinds: 30 Dark Axe Stumps and 30 Zombie Mushrooms.
Bring the crafted item to your mentor and finish the quest. You get 3,060 EXP, 804 mesos and a Crafting Catalyst.
Repeat for every other profession you have at Lv5.

Mr. Thunder (Weaponcrafting, Perion): 30 Iron Hogs and 1 Monkey Wrench. Reward: One-Handed Weapon Crafting Catalyst. Iron Hogs aren't rare: Pig Park and Pig Park II are full of them.
Francois (Tailoring, Ellinia): 30 Wild Boars and 1 Red Starry Bandana. Reward: Armor Crafting Catalyst.
Vicious (Woodcrafting, Henesys Market): 30 Dark Axe Stumps and 1 The Red Relaxer. Reward: Two-Handed Weapon Crafting Catalyst. The chair is untradeable, so craft it yourself.
JM From tha Streetz (Leatherworking, Kerning City): 30 Wild Boars and 1 Red Chair. Reward: Armor Crafting Catalyst.
Chrishrama (Arcforge, Sleepywood): 30 Horny Mushrooms and 1 Topaz. Reward: Scroll Crafting Catalyst. Ant Tunnel III has Horny and Zombie Mushrooms, so pair it with Silas's quest.
unknowns: Nobody has confirmed whether one kill counts for two active quests at once. Take both quests before you hunt, just in case.

tips: The pages are the only grind. Fairies have very high magic defense but no physical defense, so Warriors, Bowmen and Thieves kill them fastest. Magicians may want a party.

Someone Else's House is riskier at Lv28: it's Mushmom's map (Lv40 boss) and full of Iron Hogs. You reach it from Henesys through An Empty House, Pig Park and Pig Park II.
Keep the Curse Eye Tails you get in Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North VI and VII. Mr. Wetbottom's Secret Book at Lv32 needs 50.
After the pages it's a loop: Henesys, Perion, Sleepywood, Kerning City, then back to Ellinia. Stack it with your other errands in those towns.
unknowns: How fast the fairies respawn isn't confirmed. With only 2 per map, expect some waiting.

steps.text: After Jane and the Mushroom, reach level 44, talk to Jane in Lith Harbor and accept Jane's First Challenge.
Kill 50 Copper Drakes and 50 Wraiths, collect 25 Drake Skulls and 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes, and buy 1 Pure Water.
Bring it all to Jane for 10 Elixirs, then accept Jane's Second Challenge.
Kill 50 Wraiths and 50 Maladies, and collect 25 Medicine With Weird Vibes and 25 Malady's Experimental Frogs.
Get 3 Drake's Blood and 1 Mushmom Spore. Free up a Use slot and hand everything to Jane for 15 Power Elixirs.
Accept Jane's Final Challenge. Kill 100 Dark Axe Stumps and 50 Drakes, and collect 20 Dragon Skins and 10 Sap of Ancient Tree.
Get a Moon Rock from Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia, or buy one.
With a free Use slot, bring Jane the Moon Rock, Dragon Skins and Sap for a random gloves attack scroll.

items.name: Gloves Attack Scroll: Intermediate
items.note: Final challenge: you get one of the four

rewards.other: Every challenge gives 9,940 EXP and 1,389 mesos.

quests.missable: Keep a free Use slot when you hand in the second and final challenges. Jane needs it to give you the Power Elixirs and the gloves scroll.
tips: This is tough at 44: Maladies are Lv55 (weak to holy, resist fire and ice) and Drakes are Lv50. Many players train Drakes from about Lv48.
East Rocky Mountain VII has both Dark Axe Stumps and Copper Drakes.
Buy the rare ingredients instead of farming them: Drake's Blood, Sap of Ancient Tree and the Moon Rock are all tradeable.
Doing Pia's Present For a Friend too? Farm 80 Medicine With Weird Vibes from Wraiths in one trip (50 here, 30 for Pia).
Dragon Skin is shared with Ronnie (10) and Pia (30).
unknowns: The level you need before Arwen will make a Moon Rock isn't confirmed (possibly 40).
Stumpy also drops Sap of Ancient Tree, but its level and spawn spot aren't published yet.

quests.name: Echoes of the Abyss
quests.inGame: In game: Matters of the Heart and A Memory of Iron
quests.summary: Carry Nyroth's scorched scroll to Jaime, then defeat 50 Echopus, for 20,800 EXP, a random Cape Accuracy Scroll, 15 Watermelons and 10 Lemons. Not playable until Forgotten Hollow opens.
quests.card: Carry Nyroth's Scorched Arcon Scroll to Jaime, then defeat 50 Echopus.
cardRewards: Armor scroll|Cape Accuracy Scroll (Intermediate or Greater, random)

start.directions: Once it opens, walk north from Ellinia through The Field Up North of Ellinia, The Tree That Grew I and The Forest North of Ellinia. Enter The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North and go down into Forgotten Hollow.

prereqs: Forgotten Hollow has to be open (from Nov 18, 2026).

collect.name: Scorched Arcon Scroll
collect.note: Given by Nyroth when you accept Matters of the Heart.

steps.text: Talk to Nyroth in the Forgotten Hollow village and accept Matters of the Heart. He gives you a Scorched Arcon Scroll.
Go down to Decayed Tunnel III and give the scroll to Jaime the Wandering Explorer for 10,400 EXP and a random Cape Accuracy Scroll.
Accept A Memory of Iron from Jaime.
Defeat 50 Echopus. Perilous Descent I and II have the most.
Report back to Jaime for 10,400 EXP, 15 Watermelons and 10 Lemons.

items.name: Cape Accuracy Scroll: Intermediate
items.note: You get this one or the Greater one

items.name: Cape Accuracy Scroll: Greater
items.note: You get this one or the Intermediate one

rewards.other: You get one random Cape Accuracy Scroll (Intermediate or Greater). Each quest pays 10,400 EXP + 1,418 mesos.

tips: Echopus are Lv45 and weak to lightning.
Keep going afterward: A Fragile Sanctuary (Daniel the Scholar, Lv50) picks up the story.
Luma should sell Return Scrolls to Forgotten Hollow (800 mesos), which take you straight to the village.
unknowns: Forgotten Hollow opens Nov 18, but these two quests may not start until Dec 9.
The unlock order isn't clear yet. Matters of the Heart is tied to an earlier Forgotten Hollow quest, so you may need to finish another quest before Nyroth offers it.
An extra step (20 Rafflesia Petals for 25 Blue Potions) isn't in the current version but could still show up. The final turn-in to Jaime isn't confirmed either.

quests.name: Icarus and the Flying Medicine
quests.inGame: In game: In search of Wing the Fairy, The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine and Delivering the Flying Medicine
quests.summary: Help Icarus fly: win over Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, bring her 50 Medicine With Weird Vibes and 20 Witchgrass Leaves, then deliver the Flying Medicine. 29,160 EXP, 25 Blue Potions and a random Icarus Cape.
quests.card: Find Wing the Fairy, bring her 50 Medicine With Weird Vibes and 20 Witchgrass Leaves, then deliver the medicine to Icarus.
cardRewards: Green Icarus Cape|Green, Yellow or Blue Icarus Cape (random)

start.directions: Icarus is in Kerning City town. Wing the Fairy, the other NPC in this chain, is in Ellinia town.

prereqs: Finish Icarus and the Balloon (Lv31), the end of Icarus's Dream (Icarus's Hang Glider comes before it).
I'm Bored 1 and I'm Bored 2 (Icarus, Lv11) come before those.

chain.name: In search of Wing the Fairy
The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine

collect.name: Medicine With Weird Vibes
collect.note: Tradeable, so you can also buy it.

collect.name: Witchgrass Leaf
collect.note: Untradeable. Break Witch's Herb plants: 3 hits, from their left side.

collect.name: Flying Medicine
collect.note: Given by Wing when you accept Delivering the Flying Medicine.

steps.text: Talk to Icarus in Kerning City and accept In search of Wing the Fairy. One dialogue choice is wrong: if he says 'think OUTSIDE the box!', talk to him again.
Go to Ellinia and talk to Wing the Fairy for 7,560 EXP.

Accept The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine. Wing quizzes you: pick 'About the Flying Medicine...', then 'I really need that medicine, though.', then 'I wouldn't even be here if not for Icarus...'.
Collect 50 Medicine With Weird Vibes from Wraiths on the Kerning City subway: Line 1 <Area 3> and <Area 4>, Line 2 <Area 2> and <Area 3>.
Collect 20 Witchgrass Leaves by breaking Witch's Herb plants in the Kerning City swamps. Hit them from the left.
Bring both to Wing in Ellinia for 10,800 EXP and 25 Blue Potions.
Accept Delivering the Flying Medicine. Wing hands you the Flying Medicine.
Take the medicine to Icarus in Kerning City (if he doesn't take it, try Wing) for 10,800 EXP and a random Icarus Cape.

items.name: Green Icarus Cape
items.note: Lv46, +2 DEX, +21 W.DEF, +9 M.DEF, +3 ACC, 5 slots

rewards.other: You get one of the three Icarus Capes at random.

tips: Do it while you train on Wraiths. They're Lv48 and undead, so Heal hurts them, and their subway lines are among the best EXP on Victoria Island.
Medicine With Weird Vibes is tradeable, so you can buy it. Witchgrass Leaves are untradeable, so break the herbs yourself.
Witch's Herbs grow on the same swamp maps as Ligators and Crocos, so stack this with The Alligators at the Swamp (Lv48).
The capes are tradeable, so you can swap colors with a friend.
unknowns: Witch's Herb plants are the reported source of Witchgrass Leaves, but that isn't fully confirmed, and nobody knows yet how many leaves each plant gives.
Stats for the Yellow and Blue Icarus Capes aren't confirmed yet.

quests.name: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel
quests.summary: Bring Luke a Black Feather, 10 Orihalcon Ingots, 20 Screws, 30 Drake Skulls and 20 Dragon Skins for 10,800 EXP and a Bronze Crusader Helm, a Lv50 warrior hat. The Black Feather is costly, so it's mostly worth it for warriors.
quests.card: Bring Luke a Black Feather, 10 Orihalcon Ingots, 20 Screws, 30 Drake Skulls and 20 Dragon Skins.
cardRewards: Bronze Crusader Helm|Bronze Crusader Helm (Lv50 warrior hat)
quests.jobs: All jobs (the helm is warriors only)

start.directions: From Henesys walk The Road to the Dungeon, then Henesys Dungeon Entrance. Luke guards the entrance.

prereqs: Finish Luke the Security Guy (Lv19).

chain.name: Luke the Security Guy's Wish to Travel

collect.name: Black Feather
collect.note: Untradeable, no known drop. Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia makes it from a Flaming Feather, Moon Rock and Black Crystal for 30,000 mesos.

collect.name: Orihalcon Ingot
collect.note: Smithing: 5 Orihalcon Ore make 1 ingot (50 ore in all). Tradeable.

collect.name: Screw
collect.note: Weaponcrafting: 1 Bronze Ingot + 1 Iron Ingot make 10. Tradeable.

collect.name: Drake Skull
collect.note: Tradeable.

collect.name: Dragon Skin
collect.note: Tradeable.

steps.text: Talk to Luke at Henesys Dungeon Entrance and accept the quest.
Get a Moon Rock: Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia makes one from a Bronze, Iron, Mithril, Adamantium, Silver, Orihalcon and Gold Ingot plus 10,000 mesos. Or buy one.
Have Arwen make the Black Feather from a Flaming Feather, the Moon Rock and a Black Crystal (30,000 mesos).
Smith 10 Orihalcon Ingots from 50 Orihalcon Ore, and craft or buy 20 Screws.
Hunt Drakes for 30 Drake Skulls and 20 Dragon Skins. Copper Drakes and Red Drakes drop them too.
Bring everything to Luke for 10,800 EXP and the Bronze Crusader Helm.

items.name: Bronze Crusader Helm
items.note: Lv50 warrior hat, +5 DEX, +54 W.DEF, +5 ACC, 7 slots, needs 90 STR and 40 DEX

rewards.other: Every job gets the helm, but only warriors can wear it. It's tradeable.

tips: The Black Feather is the costly part: a Moon Rock trades around 30,000 mesos (Oct 23), and Flaming Feathers have no confirmed drop, so check the Free Market.
Not a warrior? The EXP doesn't cover the cost, so skip it unless a warrior friend wants the tradeable helm.
Farm the Drake Skulls and Dragon Skins together. Most players start on Drakes around Lv48.
unknowns: Nobody has confirmed which monsters drop Drake Skulls, Dragon Skins and Flaming Feathers in Classic. Drakes are the best bet.
Arwen may need you to be a certain level (possibly Lv40) before she crafts for you.

quests.name: Another of Maya's Collections
quests.inGame: In game: Maya's Third Collection and Maya's Last Collection
quests.summary: Bring Maya 30 each of four monster drops, then 50 Stone Golem Rubble, 50 Dark Stone Golem Rubble and a Diamond. 22,800 EXP, 25 White Potions and a Green Napoleon cape.
quests.card: Bring Maya 30 each of four monster drops, then 50 Stone Golem Rubble, 50 Dark Stone Golem Rubble and a Diamond.

start.directions: Maya is on Henesys Townstreet in Henesys.

prereqs: Finish Maya's First Collection and Maya's Second Collection (Lv30).
Those need Delivering the Weird Medicine, the end of Maya and the Weird Medicine (Lv21).

maps: The Land of Wild Boar II

collect.name: Stone Golem Rubble
collect.note: Tradeable.

collect.name: Dark Stone Golem Rubble
collect.note: Only this quest uses it.

collect.name: Diamond
collect.note: Arcforge: 1 Diamond Ore makes 1 Diamond (1,200 mesos).

steps.text: Talk to Maya on Henesys Townstreet and accept Maya's Third Collection.
Collect 30 Iron Hog's Metal Hooves from Iron Hogs (The Land of Wild Boar II) and 30 Lupin Dolls from Lupins (Monkey Swamp I).
steps.map: The Land of Wild Boar II

steps.text: Collect 30 Cold Eye Tails from Cold Eyes and 30 Tortie Shells from Torties (Hot Sand).
Bring all four to Maya for 11,400 EXP and 25 White Potions.
She isn't done: talk to her again and accept Maya's Last Collection.
Collect 50 Stone Golem Rubble from Stone Golems at Golem's Temple, past Henesys Dungeon Entrance.
Collect 50 Dark Stone Golem Rubble from Dark Stone Golems in Sleepy Dungeon III to V.
Make a Diamond from 1 Diamond Ore with Arcforge, or buy one.
Hand everything to Maya for 11,400 EXP and the Green Napoleon.

items.name: Green Napoleon
items.note: Lv50 cape, +3 DEX, +22 W.DEF, +4 ACC, 5 slots

rewards.other: Each part pays 11,400 EXP + 1,477 mesos.

tips: Stone Golems are Lv56 and Dark Stone Golems Lv58. You miss more against monsters above your level, so expect misses in your 40s.
Building a New House For Blackbull (Lv48) wants 100 Stone Golem Rubble too, so farm 150 in one trip.
Keep your Iron Hog's Metal Hooves for this quest instead of turning them into Screws.
Diamond Ore is cheap (about 272 mesos on Oct 23), so the Diamond is the easy part.
unknowns: Where Cold Eyes live in Classic isn't confirmed yet.
The drops for these items aren't confirmed for Classic. The monsters listed are the usual sources.

quests.name: The Alligators at the Swamp
quests.inGame: In game: Taking Out the Alligators 1 and Taking Out the Alligators 2
quests.summary: Clear the Kerning City swamps for Ayan in Perion: 40 Jr. Neckis, 100 Ligators and 20 Jr. Necki Skins, then 120 Crocos and 50 Croco Skins. 23,600 EXP, a Greater weapon attack scroll and an Intermediate cape stat scroll, both your pick.
quests.card: Defeat 40 Jr. Neckis and 100 Ligators, then 120 Crocos, and bring back 20 Jr. Necki Skins and 50 Croco Skins.
cardRewards: Weapon scroll|Greater weapon attack scroll (your pick)
Armor scroll|Intermediate cape stat scroll (your pick)

start.directions: Ayan is in Perion town. The swamps are by Kerning City: from there walk The Swamp of Despair I, II and III, then Dangerous Croko I and II.

prereqs: Finish I Need to Find My Daughter 2 (Ayan, Lv11).
That one follows The Stump Horror Story (Ayan, Lv10) and I Need to Find My Daughter 1 (Bruce, Lv11).

collect.name: Jr. Necki Skin
collect.note: Tradeable, about 33 mesos (Oct 23).

steps.text: Talk to Ayan in Perion and accept Taking Out the Alligators 1.
Go to Kerning City and walk into the swamps. The Swamp of Despair I is the first map.
Defeat 40 Jr. Neckis and 100 Ligators, and collect 20 Jr. Necki Skins.
Return to Ayan for 11,800 EXP and pick a Greater attack scroll for your weapon.
Accept Taking Out the Alligators 2.
Defeat 120 Crocos and collect 50 Croco Skins in Dangerous Croko I and II.
Return to Ayan for 11,800 EXP and pick an Intermediate cape STR, DEX, INT or LUK scroll.

items.name: Greater weapon attack scroll
items.note: Part 1. Pick one for a weapon your class uses (magicians: wand or staff magic attack)

items.name: Cape STR Scroll: Intermediate
items.note: Part 2: pick one of the four cape scrolls

items.name: Cape DEX Scroll: Intermediate
items.note: Part 2: pick one of the four cape scrolls

items.name: Cape INT Scroll: Intermediate
items.note: Part 2: pick one of the four cape scrolls

items.name: Cape LUK Scroll: Intermediate
items.note: Part 2: pick one of the four cape scrolls

rewards.other: Two picks: a weapon scroll after part 1 and a cape scroll after part 2. Each part pays 11,800 EXP + 1,506 mesos.

tips: Stack it with Icarus and the Flying Medicine: the Witch's Herbs for Witchgrass Leaves grow on these same swamp maps.
Jr. Neckis (Lv21) and Ligators (Lv31) go down fast at 48. Crocos (Lv52) are the real fight, and they're weak to fire.
Jr. Neckis dodge a lot, so expect misses if your accuracy is low.
Greater weapon scrolls work 10% of the time for +4 attack, so use yours on a weapon you plan to keep.

quests.name: Building a New House For Blackbull
quests.summary: Bring Blackbull 100 Stone Golem Rubble, 30 Screws, 30 Processed Wood and his lost land deed for 11,800 EXP, +2 fame and a Greater weapon attack scroll you pick. The deed is a rare Curse Eye drop.
quests.card: Bring Blackbull 100 Stone Golem Rubble, 30 Screws, 30 Processed Wood and his lost Deed to the Land.
cardRewards: Weapon scroll|Greater weapon attack scroll (your pick)

start.directions: Blackbull is in Perion town.

prereqs: Finish Fixing Blackbull's House (Lv11).
You may need 10 fame to start it.

chain.name: Building a New House For Blackbull

collect.name: Stone Golem Rubble
collect.note: Tradeable.

collect.name: Screw
collect.note: Weaponcrafting: 1 Bronze Ingot + 1 Iron Ingot make 10. About 234 mesos each (Oct 23).

collect.name: Processed Wood
collect.note: Woodcrafting: 10 Tree Branches make 1 (100 mesos), so 300 branches in all.

collect.name: Blackbull's Deed to the Land

maps: Hunting Ground in the Deep Forest II
Hunting Ground in the Deep Forest I
Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North IX

collect.note: Rare.

steps.text: Talk to Blackbull in Perion and accept the quest. You need Fixing Blackbull's House done, and possibly 10 fame.
Collect 100 Stone Golem Rubble from Stone Golems at Golem's Temple, past Henesys Dungeon Entrance.
Craft or buy 30 Screws and 30 Processed Wood.
Hunt Curse Eyes in Hunting Ground in the Deep Forest, near Sleepywood, until Blackbull's Deed to the Land drops. It's rare.
steps.map: Hunting Ground in the Deep Forest II

steps.text: Bring everything to Blackbull for 11,800 EXP and +2 fame, and pick a Greater attack scroll for your weapon.

items.name: Greater weapon attack scroll
items.note: Pick one for a weapon your class uses (magicians: wand or staff magic attack)

rewards.other: Same scroll pick as Taking Out the Alligators 1.

tips: Pair it with Maya's Last Collection (50 Stone Golem Rubble) and farm 150 in one trip.
Accept the quest before you hunt Curse Eyes, in case the deed only drops while it's active.
Make Screws early with Weaponcrafting. Smithing and other professions use them too.
unknowns: Nobody has confirmed the deed's drop in Classic. Curse Eyes near Sleepywood are the best bet, and it's rare.
The 10-fame requirement and the +2 fame reward aren't confirmed yet.

quests.name: Manji's Old Gladius
quests.inGame: In game: Old Gladius, Reawakening the Gladius and Hero's Gladius
quests.summary: Restore Manji's old sword: take it to Chrishrama in Sleepywood, bring a Star Rock, Piece of Ice, Ancient Scroll and Flaming Feather, then return it. 38,700 EXP, 30 Blue Potions and your pick of Hero's Gladius (Lv45 warrior sword) or Skull Earrings.
quests.card: Restore Manji's old sword with a Star Rock, Piece of Ice, Ancient Scroll and Flaming Feather.
cardRewards: Old Gladius|Hero's Gladius or Skull Earrings (pick one)
quests.jobs: All jobs (the sword is warriors only)

start.directions: Manji is in Perion town. Chrishrama is in Sleepywood: from Henesys walk The Road to the Dungeon, Henesys Dungeon Entrance and Swampy Land in a Deep Forest.

prereqs: Finish Delivering the Weird Medicine, the end of Maya and the Weird Medicine (Lv21).

collect.name: Old Gladius
collect.note: Given by Manji when you accept.

collect.name: Star Rock
collect.note: Reward from Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine, or Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia makes one.

collect.name: Piece of Ice
collect.note: No known drop. Traded around 39,500 mesos (Oct 23); sometimes a reward from Arwen and the Glass Shoe.

collect.name: Ancient Scroll
collect.note: Rare. Tradeable, so check the Free Market.

collect.name: Flaming Feather
collect.note: Rare. Tradeable, so check the Free Market.

steps.text: Talk to Manji in Perion and accept Old Gladius. He gives you the Old Gladius.
Go to Sleepywood and give the sword to Chrishrama for 12,900 EXP.
Accept Reawakening the Gladius. Chrishrama needs 1 Star Rock, 1 Piece of Ice, 1 Ancient Scroll and 1 Flaming Feather. Mike at Perion Dungeon Entrance has hints.
Get the Star Rock from Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine, or have Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia make one.
Get the Piece of Ice, Ancient Scroll and Flaming Feather. They're rare, so check the Free Market before you grind.
Bring all four to Chrishrama for 12,900 EXP and 30 Blue Potions.
Accept Hero's Gladius. Chrishrama gives you the awakened sword.
Take it to Manji in Perion for 12,900 EXP. Keep the sword (Hero's Gladius) or give it back for Skull Earrings.

items.name: Hero's Gladius
items.note: Lv45 warrior one-handed sword, +62 attack, 7 slots, needs 90 STR / 40 DEX

rewards.other: Each of the three parts pays 12,900 EXP + 1,579 mesos.

quests.missable: The last choice is one-time: you get Hero's Gladius or Skull Earrings, not both.
tips: Do Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine first. Its reward is the Star Rock you need.
Piece of Ice, Ancient Scroll and Flaming Feather have no confirmed drop yet, so check the Free Market before you grind.
Only warriors can use the sword, so other jobs will want the Skull Earrings. Both are tradeable if a friend wants the other one.
unknowns: Nobody has confirmed where Ancient Scroll and Flaming Feather drop in Classic. Dark Stone Golems and Red Drakes are the best bets.
Piece of Ice has no known drop at all. Arwen and the Glass Shoe is the only known way besides buying one.

quests.name: A Fragile Sanctuary
quests.inGame: In game: A Heart of Stillness and Wood and The Sage's Burden
quests.summary: Bring Daniel the Scholar 30 Cursed Dolls and 20 Duskmander Tails, then take his warning to Grendel in Ellinia, for 25,800 EXP, a Greater bottomwear HP scroll, 15 Elixirs and more. Not playable until Forgotten Hollow opens.
quests.card: Bring Daniel 30 Cursed Dolls and 20 Duskmander Tails, then take his warning to Grendel in Ellinia.

start.directions: Once it opens, enter Forgotten Hollow through The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North (north of Ellinia). Head down through the Deep Passage to the Precipice of Darkness.

prereqs: Forgotten Hollow has to be open (from Nov 18, 2026).
Finish Echoes of the Abyss (A Memory of Iron for Jaime) first.

chain.name: A Heart of Stillness and Wood

collect.name: Cursed Doll
collect.note: A Victoria Island drop, so you can stock up now. About 62 mesos each (Oct 23).

steps.text: After A Memory of Iron, find Daniel the Scholar at the Precipice of Darkness and accept A Heart of Stillness and Wood.
Collect 30 Cursed Dolls from Zombie Lupins on Victoria Island.
Collect 20 Duskmander Tails from Duskmanders. The Precipice of Darkness has the most.
Give them to Daniel for 12,900 EXP, 15 Red Potions and a Bottomwear HP Scroll: Greater.
Accept The Sage's Burden from Daniel.
Go to the Magic Library in Ellinia and talk to Grendel the Really Old (if he doesn't take it, try Daniel) for 12,900 EXP, 15 Elixirs, 2 Mana Elixirs and 10 Lemons.

rewards.other: Each part pays 12,900 EXP + 1,579 mesos.

tips: Cursed Dolls come from Zombie Lupins on Victoria Island, so you can have all 30 ready before Forgotten Hollow opens.
Duskmanders are Lv50, weak to ice and resist poison.
A Greater HP scroll adds +20 HP when it works.
unknowns: Forgotten Hollow opens Nov 18, but these two quests may not start until Dec 9.
The unlock order for the Forgotten Hollow quests isn't clear yet. This chain should follow Echoes of the Abyss, but that could change.
Who takes The Sage's Burden isn't confirmed. Grendel is the best bet; if not, try Daniel.

quests.name: Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine
quests.summary: Climb Steps 3 to 5 of the Forest of Patience jump quest and bring Sabitrama one Double-Rooted Red Ginseng. 12,900 EXP, +2 fame and a Star Rock, which Manji's Old Gladius needs.
quests.card: Climb Steps 3 to 5 of the Forest of Patience jump quest and bring back a Double-Rooted Red Ginseng.

start.directions: From Henesys walk The Road to the Dungeon, Henesys Dungeon Entrance and Swampy Land in a Deep Forest to reach Sleepywood. The jump quest itself starts with Shane in Ellinia.

prereqs: Finish [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine (Lv25).

collect.name: Double-Rooted Red Ginseng
collect.note: Untradeable. Found at the top of the jump quest: the reddish root split in two.

steps.text: Talk to Sabitrama in Sleepywood and accept the quest.
Go to Ellinia and talk to Shane to enter the Forest of Patience. Entry should be free since you finished the Diet Medicine quest.
Climb Steps 3 to 5. Haste and movement skills only work on Step 3, Speed and Jump are reset, and summoning bags and the Teleport Rock are blocked.
At the top, pick the Double-Rooted Red Ginseng: the reddish root split in two.
Bring it to Sabitrama in Sleepywood for 12,900 EXP, +2 fame and a Star Rock.

tips: Need a Star Rock for Manji's Old Gladius? Do this quest first.
This is the Forest of Patience, entered through Shane in Ellinia. Don't mix it up with the Deep Forest of Patience at the Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood.
Sabitrama tells you to remember what the root looks like, so pick only the reddish one split in two.
If you only want the Star Rock, Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia makes one from Garnet, Amethyst, Aquamarine, Emerald, Opal, Sapphire, Topaz, Diamond and Black Crystal plus 15,000 mesos.
unknowns: Shane's entry fee, if any, isn't confirmed.
Whether picking the wrong plant costs you the run isn't confirmed.

quests.name: John's Present
quests.inGame: In game: John's Pink Flower Basket, John's Present and John's Last Present
quests.summary: Climb the Deep Forest of Patience three times for John in Lith Harbor: 10 Pink, 20 Blue, then 30 White Violas. 77,700 EXP, +5 fame, 30 Screws, a glove for your job and Lv60 Pink-Flowered Earrings.
quests.card: Climb the Deep Forest of Patience jump quest three times for 10 Pink, 20 Blue and 30 White Violas.

start.directions: John is in Lith Harbor town. The jump quest starts at the Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood town.

chain.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Pink Flower Basket
[Deep Forest of Patience] John's Last Present

collect.name: Pink Viola
collect.note: Untradeable. Found in the Deep Forest of Patience, Steps 1-2.

collect.name: Blue Viola
collect.note: Untradeable. Steps 3-4.

collect.name: White Viola
collect.note: Untradeable. Steps 5-7.

steps.text: Talk to John in Lith Harbor and accept John's Pink Flower Basket.
Go to Sleepywood and talk to the Mysterious Statue to enter the Deep Forest of Patience.
Clear Steps 1 and 2 and gather 10 Pink Violas. Haste and movement skills don't work, Speed and Jump are reset, and summoning bags and the Teleport Rock are blocked.
Bring them to John for 25,900 EXP, +1 fame and 30 Screws.
Accept John's Present, go back in through the statue, clear Steps 3 and 4 and gather 20 Blue Violas.
Bring them to John for 25,900 EXP, +1 fame and the glove for your job.
Accept John's Last Present, go back in, clear Steps 5 to 7 and gather 30 White Violas.
Bring them to John for 25,900 EXP, +3 fame and the Pink-Flowered Earrings.

rewards.other: You get the one glove that matches your job; you don't pick it. Each part pays 25,900 EXP + 2,032 mesos, and +1, +1, then +3 fame.

tips: This is the Deep Forest of Patience at the Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood, not the Forest of Patience through Shane in Ellinia.
The job gloves and the earrings are Lv60 (Work Gloves are Lv10), and the quest starts at Lv65, so you can wear them as soon as you get them.
After each turn-in John hints there may be treasure if you go back into the forest, but he promises nothing.
